test.create_query: CREATE TABLE string_size_filter_only_perf ( id UInt64, s String ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS serialization_info_version = 'with_types', string_serialization_version = 'with_size_stream', ratio_of_defaults_for_sparse_serialization = 1, index_granularity = 8192, min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 0
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO string_size_filter_only_perf SELECT number AS id, if(number < 5000, '', randomString(1024)) AS s FROM numbers_mt(500000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE string_size_filter_only_perf FINAL SETTINGS mutations_sync = 1
test.query: SELECT s FROM string_size_filter_only_perf PREWHERE empty(s) FORMAT Null SETTINGS optimize_string_size_subcolumn_with_full_read = {optimize_full_read}
SELECT s FROM string_size_filter_only_perf PREWHERE notEmpty(s) FORMAT Null SETTINGS optimize_string_size_subcolumn_with_full_read = {optimize_full_read}
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE string_size_filter_only_legacy_perf ( id UInt64, s String ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS serialization_info_version = 'with_types', string_serialization_version = 'single_stream', ratio_of_defaults_for_sparse_serialization = 0, index_granularity = 8192, min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 0
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO string_size_filter_only_legacy_perf SELECT number AS id, if(number < 5000, '', concat(if(number % 10 = 0, 'foo', 'bar'), randomString(1021))) AS s FROM numbers_mt(500000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE string_size_filter_only_legacy_perf FINAL SETTINGS mutations_sync = 1
test.query: SELECT s FROM string_size_filter_only_legacy_perf PREWHERE empty(s) FORMAT Null SETTINGS optimize_string_size_subcolumn_with_full_read = {optimize_full_read}

SELECT s FROM string_size_filter_only_legacy_perf PREWHERE notEmpty(s) AND id > 0 AND like(s, '%foo%') FORMAT Null SETTINGS enable_multiple_prewhere_read_steps = 1, optimize_string_size_subcolumn_with_full_read = {optimize_full_read}
